name: Trendline
description: Represents a trendline in a chart.
remarks: A trendline shows the trend, or direction, of data in a series. The Trendline object is a member of the Trendlines collection. The Trendlines collection contains all the Trendline objects for a single series.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Border
properties.description: Returns a Border object that represents the border of the object.

properties.name: DataLabel
properties.description: Returns a DataLabel object that represents the data label associated with the trendline. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayEquation
properties.description: True if the equation for the trendline is displayed on the chart (in the same data label as the R-squared value). Setting this property to True automatically turns on data labels. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayRSquared
properties.description: True if the R-squared value of the trendline is displayed on the chart (in the same data label as the equation). Setting this property to True automatically turns on data labels. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the index number of the object within the collection of similar objects.

properties.name: Intercept
properties.description: Returns or sets the point where the trendline crosses the value axis. Read/write Double.

properties.name: InterceptIsAuto
properties.description: True if the point where the trendline crosses the value axis is automatically determined by the regression. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value representing the name of the object.

properties.name: NameIsAuto
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel automatically determines the name of the trendline. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Order
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long value that represents the trendline order (an integer greater than 1) when the trendline type is xlPolynomial (XlTrendlineType).

properties.name: Period
properties.description: Returns or sets the period for the moving-average trendline. Can be a value from 2 through 255. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlTrendlineType value that represents the trendline type.

properties.name: Backward2
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of periods (or units on a scatter chart) that the trendline extends backward. Read/write Double.

properties.name: Forward2
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of periods (or units on a scatter chart) that the trendline extends forward. Read/write Double.

methods.name: ClearFormats
methods.description: Clears the formatting of the object.

methods.name: SetProperty
methods.signature: SetProperty(ID As String, Value As Variant)
